description: This file contains unit tests for the PermissionManager component, focusing on verifying permission statuses and ensuring permissions, particularly related to voice wake, location, and other system capabilities.

classes.name: PermissionManagerTests
classes.description: Structured test suite for verifying various permission functionalities.

methods.name: voice wake permission helpers match status
methods.description: Tests whether the voice wake permission status matches the value returned by ensureVoiceWakePermissions.

methods.name: status can query non interactive caps
methods.description: Checks that the permission status builder returns correct counts for specified capabilities.

methods.name: ensure non interactive does not throw
methods.description: Verifies that ensuring permissions for capabilities does not throw errors when in non-interactive mode.

methods.name: location status matches authorization always
methods.description: Asserts that the location permission status corresponds to the CLLocationManager's authorization status.

methods.name: ensure location non interactive matches authorization always
methods.description: Ensures that permission enforcement for location aligns with the actual authorization status, in a non-interactive context.
